title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager
Department Project Management Office (PMO) / Delivery
Reports To Delivery Manager / Head of Delivery
Experience 3+ years in project management (services / consulting environment)
Location Remote (occasional travel for client or team offsites, if required)
Employment Type Full-time
Shift Aligned to client time zones flexibility for European / North
American overlap where required
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our Project Managers set the standard for how delivery runs they own the plan, run the
governance, protect the margin, and make sure the client sees measurable return on every rupee
they spend with us.
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive Project Manager who can independently run
4–5 concurrent client projects end to end. This is a hands-on delivery role: you will run the sprint
ceremonies, own the RAID log, chase the blocker, build the dashboard, and then present the
delivery story to a client stakeholder in the same day.
The person who succeeds here brings structure to ambiguity, communicates in facts rather than
adjectives, and escalates early with a proposed solution attached. Project Mobilisation & Onboarding
Take overall responsibility for planning, coordination, execution, and completion of new client
onboarding in line with the standard onboarding playbook — delivered within the agreed
timetable and budget.
Prepare and maintain the onboarding plan, project plan, milestone schedule, resource
plan, and RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
Run project kick-off and mobilise extended teams, including internal squads, consultants, and
third-party vendors.
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and — where applicable — technical
specifications, involving all relevant stakeholders and confirming technical feasibility before
commitment.
Establish clear entry/exit criteria, acceptance criteria, and a RACI matrix (Responsible,
Accountable, Consulted, Informed) so ownership is unambiguous from day one. Service Delivery & Day-to-Day Operations
Lead day-to-day delivery of contracted services across 4–5 accounts, ensuring quality,
productivity, and continuity across distributed teams.
Ensure every project is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Coordinate internal resources and third-party vendors to ensure proper execution.
Manage the testing and acceptance regime — including phased and final acceptance — and
align milestone sign-offs to the agreed performance-based payment plan.
Manage ticket queues and support operations: incident and request management, triage,
prioritisation, SLA tracking, and closure.
Track project performance against short-term and long-term goals, and adjust constraints based
on financial and delivery analysis. Daily & Weekly Milestone Targets
Break every project plan down into daily and weekly milestones with named owners, due
dates, and a clear definition of "done" — no task carried without a date against it.
Set and communicate daily delivery targets for each squad at stand-up; confirm at end of day
what moved, what slipped, and what is at risk for tomorrow.
Own weekly milestone achievement across all 4–5 projects: track planned vs. actual
completion, calculate slippage, and publish a weekly milestone scorecard to Delivery leadership.
Maintain a target of 90% weekly milestone adherence per project; any milestone missed
must carry a documented reason, recovery plan, and revised date within 24 hours.
Run a short daily blocker review — anything blocking a daily target for more than one working
day is escalated the same day, not held to the weekly review.
Reconcile daily task closure and weekly milestone burn against sprint burndown so the sprint,
the plan, and the client commitment never drift apart.
Chase timesheet and effort logging daily so weekly effort-vs-plan variance is accurate before it
reaches Finance or the client.
Publish a weekly delivery summary every Friday per account: milestones achieved,
milestones missed with cause, upcoming week's targets, open risks, and open blockers.
Convert weekly misses into corrective action in the next planning cycle — repeated slippage on
the same workstream is treated as a structural problem, not a scheduling one. Agile & Scrum Execution
Run all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and
backlog refinement.
Own and groom the product/project backlog alongside the Product Owner and client
stakeholders.
Break epics into user stories with clear acceptance criteria; ensure stories are estimated and
sprint-ready before planning.
Track and act on velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput, and defect trends
— forecast from data, not optimism.
Apply the right framework per engagement: Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban, Waterfall, or a hybrid
model, as the contract and client maturity demand.
Continuously improve workflow efficiency; ensure retrospective actions are actually
implemented, not just recorded. Tooling, Dashboards & Reporting
Configure and administer Azure DevOps and Jira — boards, workflows, custom fields, epics/
features/stories, sprints, iterations, and release plans.
Build and maintain dashboards for sprint progress, delivery health, defect trends, SLA
adherence, resource utilisation, and risk exposure — for both team-level and executive
audiences.
Produce weekly status reports (WSR), MIS reports for senior management to support
strategic decisions, governance decks, and monthly delivery reviews.
Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, communication plans, and a live
decision/action log.
Working knowledge expected across: Confluence, ServiceNow, MS Project, MS Visio, Excel
(advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards), PowerPoint, and BI/reporting tools such
as Power BI.
Stay current on new Excel, PowerPoint, and AI-assisted productivity tooling to keep reporting
sharp and effort low. Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Operate the engagement governance model: chair operational performance meetings, support
periodic governance committee reviews, and contribute to annual strategic reviews.
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, and minutes within agreed timelines.
Manage escalations through defined governance tiers — with a documented owner, action,
and target date for every open item.
Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders on assigned accounts.
Present oral and written reports covering plans, problems, and resolutions to the appropriate
level of management.
Manage expectations proactively: flag anything that may affect timely completion the moment it
is known, never at the review. Risk, Change & Blocker Management
Proactively identify, document, and communicate risks, and propose mitigation approaches
before they become issues.
Identify roadblocks early — scope creep, technical dependencies, resource constraints, thirdparty
delays — and drive them to resolution.
Run a disciplined blocker/impediment process: log it, assign it, escalate it, close it within
agreed timelines.
Manage all changes to scope, schedule, and cost through a formal change-control process —
impact assessment, client approval, re-baselining.
Convert genuine scope expansion into commercial opportunity rather than absorbing it silently. Commercial & Resource Management
Manage project budget and resource allocation; monitor costs and track expenses to protect
delivery margin.
Support Work Orders, SOWs, and Change Requests — including scope, volumes, charges,
and applicable service levels.
Communicate resource requirements and availability ahead of need, not at the point of crisis.
Track and follow up on client invoices and receivables in coordination with Finance.
Ensure sufficient, competent staffing and team continuity across extended teams and
consultants. Quality, Security & Compliance
Ensure final deliverables meet both the agreed brief and the technical requirements.
Ensure delivery complies with contractual security requirements, data processing obligations,
supplier code of conduct, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Maintain audit-ready project documentation at all times. People & Continuous Improvement
Mentor team members on Agile practice, delivery hygiene, and stakeholder communication.
Support team building, resourcing, and retention within a distributed working model.
Continuously identify ways to improve quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of delivery in line
with engagement improvement commitments.
EXPERTISE YOU'LL BRING
Must-Have
3+ years of project management experience, ideally in an IT services, consulting, digital
agency, or managed-services environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage 4–5 concurrent projects without letting delivery quality slip
on any of them.
Hands-on proficiency with Azure DevOps and Jira — configuration and reporting, not just
usage.
Strong practical command of Agile and Scrum, backlog management, sprint execution, and
ceremony facilitation.
Working knowledge of RACI, RAID logs, change control, and structured escalation/
blocker mechanisms.
Proven discipline in setting and tracking daily and weekly milestone targets, with visible
planned-vs-actual reporting.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and incident/request management (ServiceNow or
equivalent) and time/resource management tooling.
Strong MS Office skills — Excel (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards) and PowerPoint at a clientpresentable
standard.
Excellent written and spoken English; structured, data-driven communication.
Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline, and the ability to prioritise across competing
deadlines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Project Management, Business, or a
related discipline (Master's/MBA desirable).
Proven self-management in a remote setting — reliable connectivity, a professional working
environment, and strong async communication habits.
Certification (at least one required)
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I / II)
PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, or PRINCE2 / PRINCE2 Agile
SAFe Agilist / SAFe Scrum Master
ITIL Foundation (advantage for support and managed-services engagements)
Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer (advantage)
Good-to-Have
Exposure to SLA/KPI-based engagements and commercial constructs (SOWs, Work Orders,
Change Requests).
Experience with onshore–offshore or distributed delivery models serving European or North
American clients.
Basic understanding of databases/queries, SDLC, UI/UX principles, CMS platforms, and QA/
production environments.
Familiarity with creative delivery workflows (design, content, video) where engagements are
agency-adjacent.
Exposure to regulated environments (BFSI, healthcare, public sector) or government/publicsector
project delivery.
Commercial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, margin management, and contract awareness.
QUALITIES & CHARACTERISTICS
Ownership: a strong sense of personal responsibility for your own and the team's work — you
proactively step in to ensure quality delivery within timeframes, whatever the situation.
Composure: able to lead cross-functional teams and stay calm under tight deadlines and client
pressure.
Negotiation: comfortable holding a position with a client while keeping the relationship intact.
Curiosity: eager to learn new tools, frameworks, and techniques in project management and
delivery.
Judgement: knows what to escalate, what to absorb, and what to decide alone.
KEY SUCCESS FACTORS IN THIS ROLE
Managing multiple projects and priorities across regions and time zones simultaneously.
Balancing global delivery standards with individual client expectations.
Maintaining accuracy and predictability of forecasts while running at high volume.
Building trust with clients you will rarely, if ever, meet in person.
SUCCESS INDICATORS — FIRST 6 MONTHS
All assigned projects delivered within agreed schedule, effort, and margin variance thresholds.
90% weekly milestone adherence sustained across all assigned projects, with every miss
carrying a documented cause and recovery plan.
Daily targets and weekly scorecards published consistently without prompting from leadership.
Live, accurate dashboards available to leadership and clients without manual chasing.
Zero surprises — risks and blockers surfaced before they become escalations.
Measurable improvement in sprint predictability and velocity stability.
Clean, audit-ready documentation and a fully current RAID log across every account.
WHAT WE OFFER
100% remote working with a distributed, delivery-focused team.
Exposure to diverse clients, domains, and technology stacks — broader in a year than most
product roles give in three.
Certification sponsorship and structured learning support.
Real ownership from day one — you run your accounts, not someone else's checklist.
Note: Adjust tool names and certification preferences to match your actual delivery stack before
publishing.

Key Skills: Agile/Scrum,Project Management,Azure DevOps,Sprint Planning & Execution,Scrum,Sprint Review,JIRA,IT Project Management
